verdicts.note: The cited S3 passages are about state water-rights adjudication and 'overbearing regulation' of citizens' property and work. That is state regulation of individuals, not state mandates on local governments, zoning, annexation or regional authorities. The only local-government angle is her line that the 'one size fits all for any given county' water approach is damaging, which leans toward local tailoring but is indirect. Her 'return the education of our children to local schools' line [S6] is school governance and cannot count here under the 2026-10-08 addendum. The direction holds, but the axis fit is inferential, so low confidence.
